fact.en: Assuming the Aryans were familiar with the Ganges: The Rig Veda mentions the Ganges only once, indicating they were not yet established in the Gangetic plain.
fact.hi: Assuming the Aryans were familiar with the Ganges: The Rig Veda mentions the Ganges only once, indicating they were not yet established in the Gangetic plain.

fact.en: Confusing Rig Vedic geography with the Later Vedic period: The Rig Vedic Aryans were confined to the Sapta-Sindhu; they expanded eastward to Kuru-Panchala only in the later Vedic period.

fact.en: Mistaking the sea (Samudra) in Rig Veda for the modern ocean: It likely referred to the collection of water or the Indus river delta.
